arabic text: Lo Muhammad kay Alamdar kah matam karlo.
Khaakh urhao kay Ali Shair-e-Khuda maray gayai\n\nBaazu-e-Ahmed-e-Mukhtar ka matam karlo.
english translation text: Cast dust upon yourselves, for Ali, the Lion of God, has been slain.\n\nMourn the strength and support of Ahmad the Chosen.

arabic text: Jo kay pancho main bhi hai baara Imaamon main\nbhi hai \nSaray Nabiyon kay madadghar ka matam karlo.
english translation text: He is among the Five and also among the Twelve Imams.\nHe is among them.\nMourn the helper of all the prophets.

arabic text: Milkay Jibreel kay ustaad ka pursa day do \nSahib-e-duldul-o-talwaar ka matam karlo.
english translation text: Together, offer condolences for the teacher of Jibraeel.\nMourn the master of Duldul and the sword.

arabic text: Apnay qaatil ko diya jisnay kai jaam-e-shireen \nKausari-e-jaam kay Mukhtar ka matam karlo.
english translation text: He gave even his own killer a sweet drink.\nMourn the chosen one who owns the cup of Kawthar.

arabic text: )Qaatile marhabo antar pe bahawo aansu\nSaal ke jaffar e tayyar ka matam karlo
english translation text: Shed tears for the slayer of Marhab and Antar.\nMourn the brother of Jafar-e-Tayyar.

arabic text: )Hai islaam ke liye jiska hai marna jeena\nAaj usi haider e karrar ka matam karlo
english translation text: His living and dying were entirely for Islam.\nToday, mourn that very Haider-e-Karrar.
